name: You are a senior front-end engineer,

messages.content:
You are a senior front-end engineer, creative developer and UI/UX designer. Build a creative, professional, fast personal portfolio website for me, mobile-first and fully responsive (phone, tablet, desktop). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript (or an Astro/Next.js static export if you judge it clearly better), with no heavy dependencies, so it can be deployed for free on GitHub Pages or Vercel. At the end, give a short README with the file structure, how to run it locally and how to deploy it.

## About me (use ONLY this information)
- Name: Amir Girgis Mofid
- Headline: Software Development Student (C# / ASP.NET Core) | Digital Marketing & AI Automation | Founder, Market Sphere X
- Location: Giza, Egypt
- Contact: amirgargas28@gmail.com | +20 122 364 6440 | linkedin.com/in/amir-girgis-9392aa340 | github.com/amir-girgis
- Summary: Software development student at EVA International School of Applied Technology (Technical Diploma in Software Development, expected 2027), studying through a USAID-supported scholarship. Founder & Team Leader of Market Sphere X Agency (digital marketing, branding, web development, AI automation, since March 2024). Passionate about entrepreneurship, technology, youth empowerment and international cooperation.

## Sections (in this order)
1. Hero: large creative typographic intro with my name, headline, one-line value statement, my photo, and buttons "View Projects", "Download CV" (link to /Amir_Girgis_CV.pdf) and "Contact Me".
2. About: short, human, first person, with my photo.
3. Experience:
   - Founder & Team Leader, Market Sphere X Agency (March 2024 – Present): leads a cross-functional team (web development, graphic design, video production, photography, AI automation, business development, sales); delivers websites, branding, social media strategy and AI workflow automation for clients, mainly real estate companies in Egypt. Team size: [TEAM_SIZE]. Clients: 11.
   - School Ambassador, PHP Team Leader, Peer Assistant and Student Professional Mentor at EVA: supports 60+ students in technical and professional development.
4. Projects (cards with short description and tool tags):
   - AI Lead Qualification Platform: pipeline integrating Claude AI, Make, Airtable and Telegram via webhooks that scores and routes inbound leads, syncs CRM data and generates proposals/emails with one human approval step.
   - SAKAN (tagline "Your Life, Your Way."): a student-focused platform CONCEPT for students living away from their families, combining accommodation discovery and booking, study management, personal finance management, daily life organization and a proposed AI assistant. My role: concept and value proposition, audience analysis, digital marketing strategy, brand identity, social media campaigns, Instagram posts/stories/reels content, digital presence and final presentation. Do NOT claim I developed the app's software. Won 1st place at INNOVET III.
   - A clearly marked placeholder card "More projects coming soon" (no fake projects).
5. Achievements & Awards:
   - 1st Place – Digital Marketing Competition, INNOVET III – TVET ReAImagined Innovation Summit (November 9, 2026). Organized by Egypt's Ministry of Education and Technical Education with GIZ, the European Union and the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation. Team: Amir Girgis, Keroles Ayman, Ahmed Adel, Mina Sameh. Give this one a special highlighted card.
   - Winner, "Discovering" Challenge, TechSkills Forum 2026 (Mediterranean TVET Forum, inaugural edition, New Administrative Capital, Egypt), representing Egypt on an international team from Mediterranean countries. Dates: [TECHSKILLS_DATES].
6. Volunteering: Volunteer, Global Entrepreneurship Festival (GEF) 2026, Cairo, November 6–8, 2026, Digital Marketing team. Supported investors in the Deals Room: explained projects, scheduled meetings, took notes, translated English–Arabic, helped assess each project's strengths and risks, and recorded in the event form whether a project reached a deal. Received an official Volunteer Certificate.
7. Skills (grouped text, NO progress bars or percentages):
   - Backend: C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, MVC, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, SQL Server
   - AI & Automation: Claude, ChatGPT, Prompt Engineering, Make, REST APIs, Webhooks
   - Frontend & Design: HTML, CSS, Figma
   - Tools: Git, GitHub, Visual Studio
   - Digital Marketing: Strategy, Market Research, Target Audience Analysis, Social Media Marketing, Content Strategy, Campaign Planning, SEO
   - Brand & Creative: Brand Identity, Creative Direction, Visual Communication
   - Professional: Team Leadership, Collaboration, Presentation, Problem Solving
8. Education: Technical Diploma in Software Development, EVA International School of Applied Technology (expected 2027).
9. Contact: email, LinkedIn and GitHub links, plus a simple contact form that opens the visitor's mail app (mailto), no backend.

## Creative design direction
- Creative, memorable, award-style, but still professional and readable. Avoid a generic template look.
- Concept: "Builder at the intersection of code, marketing and leadership". Use a bold, large-scale typographic hero and a subtle animated gradient or geometric shapes.
- Palette: navy #0D2B5B, blue #2563A8, white, soft neutral greys, with mint #3ECF8E as a sparing accent.
- Typography: a strong display font (Space Grotesk or Sora) paired with Inter for body text. Strong hierarchy, generous spacing, consistent alignment.
- Interactions: scroll-triggered reveal animations, smooth section transitions, lift or tilt hover effects on project cards, a horizontal timeline for Experience and Achievements, animated counters ONLY for confirmed facts (60+ students mentored, 11 clients), and a custom cursor on desktop only.
- Sticky top navigation with a mobile hamburger menu and smooth scrolling.
- Light mode and dark mode toggle. Dark mode is the more cinematic version.
- Animations must be smooth on phones: use CSS animations and IntersectionObserver, avoid heavy libraries, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
- No stock photos of people, no emoji decoration, no icon overload, no skill progress bars.

## My photo
- My photo is at assets/amir.jpg. Use it in the Hero and About sections.
- Crop it as a rounded portrait or an organic blob/arch mask with a soft navy-to-mint gradient frame behind it, plus a subtle float or parallax effect.
- Use object-fit: cover, descriptive alt text ("Portrait of Amir Girgis Mofid"), lazy-load the About version, and show a fallback initials avatar ("AG") if the image fails to load.
- Do not edit my face or generate a different image of me.

## Quality requirements
- Semantic HTML, accessible (WCAG AA contrast, alt text, keyboard navigation, visible focus states).
- SEO: title, meta description, Open Graph tags, JSON-LD Person schema, favicon.
- Performance: Lighthouse 95+, no layout shift, minimal JavaScript, lazy-loaded images.
- English only, unless an English/Arabic switch with RTL support can be added without complicating the code.

## Strict content rules
- Do NOT invent metrics, testimonials, client names, certifications, projects, dates or job duties that are not listed above.
- Keep ALL text content in one data file (content.js or data.json) so I can edit it without touching the layout.
- Put [TEAM_SIZE] and [TECHSKILLS_DATES] as clearly marked, easily editable placeholders in that file, and list them at the end of your answer.

Deliver the complete working code, then the README.
